name: Navy Aviation University
zh: 中国人民解放军海军航空大学

evidence.summary: CASI describes Naval Aviation University in Yantai as a PLA Navy university formed in July 2017 by merging the Naval Flight College, which trained the navy’s shore-based and shipborne pilots and aviation commanders, with the Naval Aeronautical and Astronautical College. It operates across 11 sites in six provinces, including flight training bases in Huludao, Changzhi, Qinhuangdao and Jiyuan and a flight simulator centre in Beijing, and is equipped with fighter, bomber, transport and helicopter aircraft.
The university reports to PLA Navy headquarters.
